prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached SuperFoods "No Means No" cookie poster. Enhance this exact image for a brand website: upscale, reduce JPEG artifacts, recover natural cookie texture, improve legibility and edge clarity with restrained sharpening. Preserve the composition, hands, plate, cookies, logo, all wording, brown lower panel and warm parchment cream upper panel exactly. Keep original aspect ratio. Do not re-design, invent text, add objects or change claims. No stark white. Output a single clean high-resolution poster.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied SuperFoods product display photographed beside a Ganesh idol at a celebration. Conservatively enhance this exact photograph: upscale, gently reduce compression and noise, improve exposure of packaging without clipping highlights, recover restrained detail and natural colors. Preserve every product, the real packaging and all existing visible text, religious scene, objects and composition. Do not hallucinate or rewrite small illegible text. Remove only the dark screenshot corners by extending the adjacent image to square corners if needed. No added wording, people or objects. Maintain portrait aspect ratio.

No invented details, face changes, new text or objects. Keep original portrait aspect ratio and restore screenshot rounded corners with adjacent image where needed.
